channel.title: Open Data Actors updates
channel.description: New actor pages, guides, data pages and comparisons from Open Data Actors.

item.title: Actor page: YouTube Transcript Extractor - Text, SRT, VTT, $3/1K
item.description: YouTube Transcript Extractor - Text, SRT, VTT, $3/1K. Get YouTube transcripts and subtitles from videos, Shorts, channels, playlists or searches as plain text, timed segments, SRT or VTT, with title, channel, views, duration and caption languages. Pick languages, manual or auto. No login, no API key. Run it on Apify, with a free sample CSV.

item.title: Actor page: TikTok Scraper - Hashtags, Sounds, Places, Search
item.description: TikTok Scraper - Hashtags, Sounds, Places, Search. TikTok scraper for hashtag feeds, keyword search, account search, sounds (music), places (locations) and profile videos or reposts. Video URL, caption, views, likes, comments, shares, date, creator, music, place, subtitles, optional MP4 download and transcript. No login. Run it on Apify, with a free sample CSV.

item.title: Actor page: TikTok Followers Scraper - Followers and Following
item.description: TikTok Followers Scraper - Followers and Following. Export the follower list and following list of public TikTok profiles with username, nickname, user ID, verified badge, bio, follower, following, like and video counts. No login, no cookies. Run it on Apify, with a free sample CSV.

item.title: Actor page: TikTok Comments Scraper - Replies, Likes, Commenters
item.description: TikTok Comments Scraper - Replies, Likes, Commenters. Export TikTok comments and replies from public videos: comment text, likes, reply count, date, commenter username, nickname, user ID, avatar, pinned and liked-by-creator flags, reply threading. Paste video URLs. Plain HTTP, no login, no browser. Run it on Apify, with a free sample CSV.

item.title: Actor page: LinkedIn Posts Scraper - Search by Keyword, No Login
item.description: LinkedIn Posts Scraper - Search by Keyword, No Login. Search public LinkedIn posts by keyword, company or author with no login or cookies. Get text, likes, comments, reposts, media, hashtags, author and top comments. Filter by date and content type. Paste post URLs too. $1.50 per 1,000 posts. Run it on Apify, with a free sample CSV.

item.title: Actor page: LinkedIn Company Scraper - No Login, $2.8 per 1K
item.description: LinkedIn Company Scraper - No Login, $2.8 per 1K. Scrape public LinkedIn company pages with no login: industry, size, employees, followers, HQ address, website, specialties, all offices, similar companies and recent posts. Paste URLs, names or domains. $2.8 per 1,000; not-found free. Run it on Apify, with a free sample CSV.

item.title: Actor page: Instagram Profile Scraper - No Login, $1.8/1K
item.description: Instagram Profile Scraper - No Login, $1.8/1K. Instagram public profiles and latest posts without login: exact followers, following, posts, bio, all bio links, emails in bio, verified and private flags, plus each recent post's caption, likes, comments, date and media URLs. Engagement rate per profile. Run it on Apify, with a free sample CSV.
